project_type: PHP + MySQL web application (XAMPP), school attendance management system (SGA COBAEV)
build_system: XAMPP (Apache + MySQL), no build step needed - plain PHP files served directly
build_command: php -l (lint check on each PHP file)
test_command: php -l admin/*.php (syntax check all admin files)
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on each created PHP file to verify no syntax errors. 2. Verify files reference correct session variables and DB connection path.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - plain PHP files. conexion.php provides $pdo variable via PDO.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. No actual MySQL database available for runtime testing - validate via PHP lint only. No composer install needed for admin dashboard (uses CDN for Tailwind).
contribution_requirements: Maintain visual consistency with existing files: colors (#f7f3eb crema, #5c1931 vino, #a48253 dorado), fonts (Playfair Display serif, Plus Jakarta Sans), Tailwind via CDN. Use PDO prepared statements. Session auth check redirects to ../login_admin.php.
key_patterns: 1. conexion.php provides $pdo (PDO instance) - include via require_once '../conexion.php' from admin/. 2. Session vars: $_SESSION['usuario_autenticado'], $_SESSION['usuario_id'], $_SESSION['usuario_nombre'], $_SESSION['usuario_rol'], $_SESSION['username']. 3. CSS classes: .bg-crema, .text-vino, .bg-vino, .text-dorado, .font-serif-elegant, .font-sans-clean. 4. All pages use Tailwind CDN + Google Fonts. 5. login_admin.php sets session and redirects to checador.php currently. 6. Database uses PDO with FETCH_ASSOC and ERRMODE_EXCEPTION. 7. Tables: alumnos (varchar PK matricula), tutores (int PK id_tutor, FK matricula_alumno), asistencias (int PK id_asistencia, FK matricula_alumno), usuarios (int PK id_usuario), dispositivos_padres (int PK id, FK matricula_alumno, token_fcm TEXT).
directory_structure: Root: PHP files served directly. login_admin.php handles admin auth. conexion.php provides DB connection. admin/ subfolder (to be created) will contain the dashboard. config/ has service-account.json for FCM.
